method: Read HDF5 saved cases; exact phase-domain and interaction-domain Scheme expressions; no Fluent session contact. Units in developed solved-case coordinates supported by native wall-geometry metre coordinate equality and saved source expressions. Geometry rendered from saved native face connectivity.

wall_resolution.storage_domain: results/1/phase-1 has phaseId1, which maps to the saved-case geom-domain mixture with domain ID1. The stored y+ fields concern the shared bulk-flow wall treatment.

wall_adjacent_nearest_wall_distance.meaning: Stored nearest-wall distance for the cell adjacent to each wall face, indexed using the native mesh c0 connectivity. This is not the meshing first-layer thickness or layer count.

limitations: Boundary surfaces and source-region face topology are reproduced; no physical pool or omitted discharge geometry is added.
Coordinate extrema describe discrete mesh surfaces, not an exact CAD nominal vessel diameter.
Reference yplus=300 is a settings reference value, not a computed wall-resolution measurement.
Stored rough-wall flag is recorded without interpreting it as a version-specific wall-shift proof.
Native wall-resolution fields have been extracted from hash-matched paired data; their reported distributions do not qualify the mesh or rough-wall assumptions.
Solver-side orthogonal quality, skewness, meshing first-layer thickness and actual layer count remain unverified.
The native SV_WALL_YPLUS and SV_WALL_YPLUS_UTAU fields are recorded separately; do not substitute one definition for the other.
wall_resolution_reduction_method: Face weights are geometric polygon areas from native saved-case vertices, computed as the norm of the Newell area vector; summary means are weighted by those areas. Per-wall min/max use all faces in the named zone. Nearest-wall distance is sampled in the adjacent c0 cell for each wall face.
